topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen recognition via PAMPs and DAMPs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define molecular patterns of infection and cellular damage and outline the criteria used to distinguish foreign pathogens from host tissues.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptors and intracellular inflammatory signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the genetics, cellular localization, and downstream signaling cascades of pattern recognition receptors and inflammasomes.

topics.label: Cellular inflammatory response, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sentinel cells initiate inflammation, how leukocytes are recruited and drained through tissues, and how excessive activation causes septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inflammatory responses are resolved, how damaged tissues are repaired, and how chronic inflammation or granulomas arise when resolution fails.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
